evidence_cards.content: The C² JU shall assume R² of an IU (including C² and nonC² JUs and forwarded PUs and RUs) in accordance with the reporting rules for a real-time track if the C² JU has correlated local sensor data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the high-level objective: assuming reporting responsibility (R²) for an Interface Unit under specific conditions, which is the core goal of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: The rules for Reporting Responsibility (R²) are designed to ensure that only the JU having the best positional data available is reporting the track on the interface.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This statement defines the high-level objective of the use case, which is to establish and maintain correct reporting responsibility based on data quality.

evidence_cards.content: The objective is to ensure that C2 JUs do not transmit air, surface, or land tracks until sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration are performed after initially achieving Active status or returning to it from Inactive status or TDS Failure.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This text defines the specific operational goal regarding track transmission constraints during the transfer of reporting responsibility (or assumption of active status).

evidence_cards.content: The first JU to report a contact assumes reporting responsibility for that Track Number.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This statement defines the primary objective of the use case: establishing which entity holds the reporting responsibility for a specific track number.

evidence_cards.content: The C² JU has the responsibility to determine whether data points detected by its local sensors are currently reported on the interface and if there are any conflicts between locally derived information and information reported on the interface.

evidence_cards.content: The unit originating a J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report always retains reporting responsibility.
